descripcion_geo: Mountainous region in central Asia Minor, famous for its rock formations. Peter wrote to the believers there.

historias.descripcion: Among the pilgrims at Pentecost there are men from Cappadocia who hear the gospel.

historias.titulo: Peter addresses his letter to the believers of Cappadocia
historias.descripcion: Peter writes to the chosen pilgrims scattered throughout Cappadocia among other provinces.

historias.titulo: The great Cappadocians: theologians of the 20th century. IV
historias.descripcion: Basil the Great, Gregory of Nyssa and Gregory of Nazianzus, the 'three great Cappadocians', developed Trinitarian theology.

personajes.descripcion: He addressed his first letter to the communities of Cappadocia.
Great Cappadocian theologian who systematized the theology of the Holy Spirit.
He developed mystical theology; brother of Basilio and companion of Gregory of Nazianzus.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Cappadocia: relevant region in the world of the NT.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Cappadocian Fathers of the 4th century (Basil, Gregory of Nyssa, Gregory of Nazianzus) gave definitive form to the Trinitarian dogma that emerged at the Council of Nicaea.
